notes.title: TRIVIA WAR 2.0
notes.content:
[u][i][h1][b]Trivia War 2.0 is Here! 🎉[/b][/h1][/i][/u]

We're thrilled to announce a [b]major update[/b] to [b]Trivia War![/b] Here's everything that's new in [b]Version 2.0[/b]:

[h2]🔧 [b]Gameplay Overhaul[/b][/h2]
The [b]Gameplay Settings[/b] have been [b]completely revamped[/b] and can now be accessed [b]before every game[/b], eliminating the need to go to the settings screen!

[h2]🎮 [b]New Game Modes[/b][/h2]
We’re introducing two [b]brand new game modes[/b] to keep things fresh:

- [b]Stealth Health[/b]: Test your strategy under pressure with everyone's health completely hidden!
- [b]Arsenal Challenge[/b]: Upgrade your weapon based on your correct streak, lose your streak and start back at the beginning. 

[h2]⚡ [b]New Speed Bonuses[/b][/h2]
Two exciting new [b]Speed Bonuses[/b] have been added:

- [b]Damage Increase[/b]: Deal more damage depending on what order the player answered correctly.
- [b]Health Replenish[/b]: Have your health restored, the faster you answered the more health you gain back!

[h2]🛠️ [b]Enhanced Customization[/b][/h2]
You now have [b]more control[/b] over your game experience:

- [b]Adjust Question Time[/b]: Set how much time you have to answer each question.
- [b]Adjust Answer Time[/b]: Control how much time you have to pick your answer.
- [b]Filter Categories & Difficulty[/b]: Filter out categories you don’t enjoy and select your preferred difficulty levels.
- [b]Multiple Guesses[/b]: Allow multiple guesses per round for added strategy!

[h2]🌟 [b]Additional Features[/b][/h2]
- [b]Screen Shake[/b]: Explosions now have a [b]screen shake effect[/b] to make things even more intense! (Can be turned off in the settings)
- [b]Bluetooth Controller Delay Fix[/b]: We've added a [b]grace period[/b] to account for potential delays when using Bluetooth controllers.
- [b]CPU Difficulty Settings[/b]: The CPU’s difficulty can now be set individually for a more tailored experience!

[h2]🎉 [b]Win Screen Overhaul[/b][/h2]
The [b]Win Screen[/b] has been redesigned to be [b]more exciting[/b] and rewarding when you come out on top!

[h2]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
We've squashed a variety of bugs, including [b]performance improvements[/b] and [b]question fixes[/b] to make your game run smoother than ever.
